content:
Here is a suggested LinkedIn post:

I'm excited to share that I've joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! I've been working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017 and am thrilled to now be in a position to help drive the standard forward.

CDS Hooks is a powerful interoperability standard that enables clinical decision support to be seamlessly integrated into the clinical workflow. If your organization is already using CDS Hooks, I encourage you to add your implementation details to the CDS Hooks Availability wiki: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability.

And if you haven't yet adopted CDS Hooks, I'm available as a freelance consultant to assist you with implementation. Feel free to reach out if you'd like to discuss how CDS Hooks can benefit your organization.

I'm excited for the opportunity to contribute to the CDS Hooks standard and community. Let's work together to enable smarter, more efficient clinical decision support!
